title: Eval runner design: trusted judge, pinned base, quality verdict separate from cost
summary: orchestrate eval reads suites from the trusted checkout; test suites run each git ref in a detached worktree after overwriting runner files with the trusted copies (a candidate cannot weaken its judge); case suites run routes via delegate in a worktree pinned to the case file's base_commit. The per-candidate verdict uses only the quality dimension (pass rate + new failing tests, or accuracy); cost/latency/tokens get their own verdicts and never rescue a quality regression. Eval observations pass only when accuracy clears the family floor, and accuracy-scored samples supersede contract-only ones in CAP pass rates. Known gap: src/agent_os/orchestrator/eval.py is evaluator code but is not yet a protected path; adding it requires an operator grant (policy change).
